amendments.rule: Generic DOJ/FTC identity cannot establish antitrust; require explicit antitrust/competition/monopoly language plus enforcement action.
Recognize common inflections approve/approves/approval/approved and authorize/authorizes/authorization.
Normalize hyphen/underscore separators to spaces in title+slug only.

amendments.trigger: Synthetic EPS + FTC-acquisition title was forced to M&A because Earnings hard-exclusion removed an explicit second mechanism.
amendments.rule: When explicit EPS/earnings language and another strict family mechanism co-occur, retain EARNINGS_EPS as a hit so the cross-domain resolver returns AMBIGUOUS_MULTI_FAMILY rather than forcing a family.

precision_direction: No relaxation based on real v2 counts is permitted after first real v2 execution; later changes require a new protocol version.
